violations.text:
Food stored on floor.
Sugar on floor in dry storage.

In-use utensil in non-time/temperature control for safety food not stored with handle above top of food within a closed container.
Handle laying in sugar bin

Single-service articles improperly stored.
Pizza boxes on floor next to reach in freezer. Manger moved

Ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food prepared onsite and held more than 24 hours not properly date marked.
Cooked steak in reach in cooler made yesterday morning. Employee added date
Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items.

Handwash sink used for purposes other than handwashing.
Dump sink evidenced by ice in sink

No proof provided that food employees are informed of their responsibility to report to the person in charge information about their health and activities related to foodborne illnesses.
Emailed form to operator

No written procedures available for use of time as a public health control to hold time/temperature control for safety food.
Operator filled out form during inspection
